summary: Traverses a singly linked list searching for a node whose data object's ID field at offset 0x5C equals a2. The head pointer is read from this+0x18 (this[6]) into the traversal cursor this+0x20 (this[8]); each node stores its next pointer at +4 and its data object at +0. On a match, calls sub_406A70 with the matched data object. Returns silently when a2 is -1, the list is empty, or the end is reached without a match.

local_names.this: list container holding head (this+0x18) and traversal cursor (this+0x20)
local_names.a2: target ID to search for; -1 is the no-search sentinel
local_names.data: data object stored at the current node (node+0)

operations.description: Returns immediately when the target ID a2 is -1 (no-search sentinel)
Reads the list head from this[6] (offset 0x18) into the traversal cursor field this[8] (offset 0x20)
Proceeds only when the head pointer and its data object are both non-null; otherwise returns silently

While the ID field at offset 0x5C of the current data object does not equal a2, advances the cursor to the next node via the next pointer at node+4 and re-reads its data object; returns when the cursor becomes null (end of list)
Invokes sub_406A70 with the data object of the matched node
Returns void; every path exits without a value
